methodology.netsd: Each candidate appears once with the unchanged86 archived reference assets; its augmented maximum degree D(P) is recomputed. Existing reference assets are not duplicated.
methodology.frontiers: Attained nondominated archived-portfolio envelopes; no allocation is optimised or recommended. Connecting segments are visual guides, not certified feasible or globally optimal portfolios.
methodology.split: First70% and last30% are retrospective subperiods of frozen historical allocations, not a newly refitted rolling OOS experiment.
methodology.benchmarks: Both comparison series use dated EUR price returns. Berkshire is an individual Class B share, not a fund or index.
methodology.bootstrap: Two-sided centered circular moving-block bootstrap;2000 replicates;5,10,20-session blocks; BH correction within each period/block family. CI is arithmetic annualised mean active return; exploratory post-selection inference.
